# RELEASE NOTES TEMPLATE
# For Focus Timer Shop - All future releases must follow this structure

---

## Format: `v{VERSION} - {BETA/RELEASE} - {MC_VERSION}`

Example: `v1.0.0 - RELEASE - 1.20.1`

---

## Template Structure (English only, concise, list-based)

```markdown
# v{X.X.X} - {BETA/RELEASE} - {MC_VERSION}

> {One-sentence summary of this release}

## 📥 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader 0.15.0+](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Install [Fabric API 0.92.2+](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Download JAR below → `.minecraft/mods/`
4. {Additional steps if needed}

## ✨ New Features

- **Feature Name** - Brief description
- **Feature Name** - Brief description

## 🔧 Improvements

- **Area** - What improved
- **Area** - What improved

## 🔒 Security Fixes

_(Only if applicable)_

- **VULN-XXX** - Brief description of patch

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

_(Group by system if many bugs)_

- **BUG #XX** - Brief description
- **BUG #YY** - Brief description

## 📦 Details

- **Size**: XX KB
- **Changes**: N files modified
- **Compatibility**: Backward compatible / Breaking changes
- **Performance**: {Impact if any}

## 🎮 Systems

_(Optional - for major releases)_

List main systems included

## 📚 Resources

_(Optional)_

- [Changelog](link)
- [Documentation](link)

## ⚠️ Known Issues

_(Optional)_

- Issue description
- Issue description

Or: `None`

---

**Changelog**: https://github.com/diepanh435472-wq/FOCUS-TIMER-SHOP-MOD/compare/{prev_tag}...{current_tag}
```

---

## Key Rules

1. **English Only** - No Vietnamese or other languages
2. **Concise** - Short bullet points, easy scanning
3. **Clear Categories** - Use emojis for visual hierarchy
4. **Version Format** - Always `vX.X.X - BETA/RELEASE - MC_VERSION`
5. **Installation First** - Quick start at top
6. **List-Based** - Bullet points, not paragraphs
7. **Professional** - No casual language or jokes

---

- 📥 Installation
